name: Server Operations
description: Diagnose, maintain, and deploy to explicitly named servers over SSH with exact-target backups and live verification. Use for service health, logs, configuration, releases, remote file transfer, restarts, incident checks, or bounded production fixes.
risk_summary: Remote changes can affect production; exact targets, rollback, and action-boundary confirmation govern consequential work.
summary: Resolve the host, inspect live state, back up exact targets, make the requested change, and verify service and user-facing health.

required_evidence: Verify the intended host and exact changed targets.
Check service state and the real health or user path after the change.
stop_when: The requested server outcome is verified with a rollback point.
Host identity, authority, or safe rollback cannot be established.

limitations: An SSH exit code alone does not prove application health.
Configured SSH access does not broaden the server scope named by the user.
